title: PhD Student (M/F/D) for the Chair of AI-Assisted Therapy Decisions
institution: LMU Munich, Chair of AI-Assisted Therapy Decisions
field: Machine learning for intensive care medicine
about: Three-year PhD position at LMU Munich's Chair of AI-Assisted Therapy Decisions (MCML PI Björn Eskofier) in AIM-ICU, a BMFTR-funded project on ICU monitoring and treatment insights. Starts as soon as possible; applications close 30 November 2026.
requirements: Excellent Master's degree or equivalent in computer science, artificial intelligence or a closely related field
Strong background in machine learning and deep learning, Python and PyTorch
Desirable: longitudinal data, NLP, transformers or clinical data analysis
Apply with a single English PDF (CV, transcripts, reference letters, motivation letter) by e-mail to the contact named in the posting

upskill.name: Deep Learning & Neural Architectures I
why: "Strong background in machine learning and deep learning, Python and PyTorch" → "Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs): image recognition, object detection, segmentation"
"Desirable: longitudinal data, NLP, transformers or clinical data analysis" → "Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs), LSTMs, GRUs: sequence modelling, time series"
"Desirable: longitudinal data, NLP, transformers or clinical data analysis" → "Transformer architecture (2017): self-attention; backbone of all modern LLMs and vision models"
